versions.subject: rules: registry, tamper with Defender & LSA
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: \reg.exe
    CommandLine|contains: 'SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' add '
        - ' /d 0'
        - ' /v RunAsPPL '
selection_target:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'Real-Time Protection'
        - 'TamperProtection'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\reg.exe" CommandLine="*SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa*" CommandLine="* add *" CommandLine="* /d 0*" CommandLine="* /v RunAsPPL *"
